verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community report that Fastmail itself can fetch mail from and send through Gmail like a mail client. That is a product-side way to pull an external account into Fastmail, but nothing covers Microsoft 365, generic IMAP accounts, or managing several external accounts together. The 'Logging in to multiple accounts' doc is a bare title with no content showing cross-provider support, and the import tool is one-off migration rather than ongoing unified access. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of external-account fetching, Microsoft 365 support, generic IMAP account support, evidence of handling several accounts in one unified view, and hands-on corroboration beyond one comment.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can connect several accounts across providers — Gmail, Microsoft 365, IMAP — and work them from one place

citations.quote: you can configure Fastmail to fetch mail from (and send via) Gmail like a mail client.
